title: Rabbi Chunya, father-in-law of Rabbi Ami
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Mentioned in Yalkut, I Kings, section 179. Hyman calls this a scribal error, identifying its source as Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:11, which reads Rabbi Yannai, father-in-law of Rabbi Ami. Thus we find in Chullin 111a that Rabbi Ami had a son named Yannai.

notes.text: Hyman connects Ami’s proposed father-in-law Yannai with Ami’s son Yannai; this is his inference, not a new genealogical adoption.

Yalkut Shimoni has Chunya in the statement about ordering. The consulted Shir HaShirim Rabbah has Yannai in that statement. Chullin 111a separately names a son of Rabbi Ami. Hyman supplies the connection between the readings.
